2026-08-25 12:06:17.371 |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-08-25 12:06:17.371 | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-08-25 12:06:17.371 |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-08-25 12:06:17.371 | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-08-25 12:06:17.371 |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
2026-08-25 12:06:17.371 | • In case of template units, the unit is meant to be enabled with some
2026-08-25 12:06:17.371 |   instance name specified.
